**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Total cost of all the copies of all the shops 

⇒ (42 + 38 + 61 + 39 + 51 + 59 + 60) × 70 

⇒ (350) × 70 = Rs. 24500

**∴ The total cost of all the copies of the book that got sold on that day from all these seven shops taken together is Rs. 24500.**
